title: Practice 3: The family of пасть (попа́сть, упа́сть)

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **впали** — впасть (perfective): (river) to fall (into), to flow (into); (a condition) to fall (into), to lapse (into), to sink (into); (cheeks, eyes etc.) to sink in, to become hollow/sunken. Wiktionary: в- + пасть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **впасть** — впасть (perfective): (river) to fall (into), to flow (into); (a condition) to fall (into), to lapse (into), to sink (into); (cheeks, eyes etc.) to sink in, to become hollow/sunken. Wiktionary: в- + пасть.

exercises.why: **Выпало** — вы́пасть (perfective): to drop out, to fall out; to come out; (of hair) to fall out, to come out; to fall (precipitations, sediments). Wiktionary: вы́- + пасть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: depression, hollow, trough, scoop (area that is lower than its surroundings)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: упа́вший — fallen, dropped; распа́д — disintegration, breakup, collapse; впа́дина — depression, hollow, trough, scoop (area that is lower than its surroundings); упа́док — decline, decay, decadence.

exercises.q: Actinium-227 is a decay product of uranium-235.
